CoverageInsurance.title: Coverage Insurance
CoverageInsurance.subtitle: Subscribe to platform-hosted chargeback coverage for new orders.
CoverageInsurance.product_description: Filix Pay provides integrated dispute coverage through our platform insurance partners.
CoverageInsurance.unavailable_body: Platform coverage is being prepared. Please check back later or contact support.
CoverageInsurance.agreement_body: By subscribing, you authorize Filix Pay to apply platform-hosted chargeback coverage to eligible new orders under the current service agreement.
CoverageInsurance.agreement_checkbox: I have read and agree to the coverage service agreement (v1).
CoverageInsurance.unsubscribed_banner: Coverage is turned off for new orders. Existing claims will continue to be processed.

unsubscribe_modal.title: Turn off coverage?
unsubscribe_modal.warning: After you turn off coverage, new orders will no longer be covered by platform chargeback insurance. Existing claims will continue to be processed without interruption.
